answer: Locks are recorded in atlas, expire in fable, and ferrous lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 96 aliases therefore needs 64 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3015 identities would post 3558 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
